rawSiteProfile.name: Bullseye North
rawSiteProfile.notes: Celerant/ColdFusion storefront (bullseyenorth_cf). HTTP/1.1 headers have trailing whitespace before colons (e.g. "X-Frame-Options : SAMEORIGIN") which makes Node's llhttp parser throw HPE_INVALID_HEADER_TOKEN. The project http-client catches axios "Parse Error" and falls back to native fetch, which handles non-standard headers cleanly (http-client.ts:344-347). Verified 3/3 successful fetches via native-fetch on 2026-04-14 — Playwright NOT required. Sort baked into URL path (/orderby/<value>). Site's perpage option has dynamic "All" value set to total product count in the storefront-visible inventory (3117 today, 3153 earlier — fluctuates per request). Sitemap has 3,878 product URLs but 838 of those are out-of-stock special-order items hidden from /all-products/browse listings; not indexable as buyable inventory. No WAF detected.

steps.notes: a.product anchor tags on /all-products/browse listing pages. Product detail URL pattern: /shop/<slug>-<numericId>. Numeric ID is stable Celerant item ID (e.g. 37297 for the newest arrival). Pagination uses path style /page/{N} (NOT query). Sliding-window pagination: page 1 only shows links to pages 2-4 in nav, but direct /page/N URLs work for all N up to the end. End-of-pagination detected by 0 products on page (verified pages 88-89 return 0).

walkProof.notes: Walked pages 1-89 via HTTP GET (native-fetch fallback each). Pages 1-87 returned 36 products each (3132 gross). Dedupe to 3114 unique (18 boundary duplicates). Pages 88-89 returned 0 products. Matches perpage=3117 All-option within ±3 (cache jitter).

sortIdJumpVerified.verdict: honored — all 3 newest-style sorts produce distinct first-product IDs. new-arrivals is the canonical Celerant "newest to storefront" sort; newest-rcvd is "newest received by warehouse" (different metric).

rawSiteProfile.coverageNotes: Sitemap has 3,878 distinct numeric product IDs (extracted via regex /-(\d{3,})<\/loc>/ from /sitemap.xml). Catalog listing /all-products/browse exposes only 3,117 (active, storefront-visible, not special-order). Gap of ~761 = out-of-stock special-order items (verified sample: all 5 tested returned HTTP 200 product detail pages with "out of stock, special order" markers). These are NOT indexable as buyable inventory. Active-inventory coverage via /all-products/browse/orderby/new-arrivals/perpage/36 = 3117/3117 = 100%.

wafWorkaround.notes: Celerant/ColdFusion sends malformed HTTP/1.1 headers (trailing whitespace before colons). Project http-client catches "Parse Error" from axios/undici and falls back to native fetch via nativeFetchFallback() at http-client.ts:277-302. Verified 3/3 reliable on 2026-04-14. Playwright is no longer required — needsPlaywright field removed as it was unused by production code (only informational).
steps: axios GET (fails with HPE_INVALID_HEADER_TOKEN on HTTP/1.1)
native fetch handles trailing-space headers cleanly → returns 200 + 150KB HTML

rawSiteProfile.wafProbeResult: No WAF. 8/8 batches 200 OK. server: Null. No cf-ray/x-sucuri-id/visid_incap cookies. Burst of 10 GETs in 2s: no rate-limit. Honeypot (wp-admin, .env, .git/config): all 200 (server ignores path, returns 16KB default page). SQLi/XSS payloads: 200. UA rotation (desktop/mobile/bot/curl): 200. Only observation: CFID/CFTOKEN session cookies on every response, classic ColdFusion.
rawSiteProfile.wafProbeEvidence: Batch 1 headers: "server: Null", "set-cookie: CFID=...", "set-cookie: CFTOKEN=...". Batch 3 burst: 10 GETs all 200 in ~9s total, no 429/503. HTTP/1.1 response shows malformed trailing-space headers: "X-Frame-Options : SAMEORIGIN\r\n"

productUrlSchemes.notes: Each product has TWO URL forms both returning same detail page: canonical /shop/<slug>-<id> (from /all-products/browse listings) and /<brand-slug>/<slug>-<id> (from /sitemap.xml). Both 200. SourceId extractor regex /-(\d{4,})(?:[?#]|$)/ in generic-retail.ts:1028 matches both.

productCountMethod.notes: Celerant renders the <select id="perpage"> with a dynamic final option value="<N>" label="All" where N is the total storefront-visible product count. Value fluctuates 3117-3153 across requests (cache jitter). Extract via regex: /value="([0-9]+)"[^>]*>\s*All\s*<\/option>/. This is a MORE reliable ground truth than walking pagination (which also returns ~3100-3120 unique products with boundary dedupe noise).

topLevelCategories.source: /sitemap.xml top-level <loc> entries, parent categories before /brand/* entries
topLevelCategories.totalsSumCheck: 491+452+154+168+163+454+1147+309 = 3338 (vs /all-products All=3153: ~5% overlap across parent categories). Walking 8 parents with perpage={all}+50 yielded 3,140 unique IDs on 2026-04-14; using /all-products alone yields 3,117. Parent-category partitioning NOT needed — single /all-products URL gives equivalent coverage.
